== Introduction ==
[[NQR Summercup]] was played in the summer of 2004. There were two competitions, first there was the classic cup with 48 teams and there was a custom cup with 32 teams. After first rounds play the losing teams went to the Amateur cups and the winning teams played for the medals in the Pro cup.
